name: pdk-tap-jaffle-shop-etl
instr:
Our POS now writes a nightly export, one folder per day named by date, holding the same CSV files jafgen writes. A sample of last week's exports is in /data/jaffle-exports/.

tap-jaffle-shop should read these instead of simulating when a new `export_path` setting points at that folder, sending the same six streams with the same fields, key properties and SCHEMA types as the simulated ones, whatever an export holds. An empty field goes out as null.

We sync nightly with the previous sync's last STATE. Each sync sends the orders, items and customers no earlier sync sent, plus those the shop has changed since, each once with its latest values; one that just shows up again unchanged isn't. Stores, products and supplies go out in full every sync, as in the newest export.

Sometimes the POS is still writing an export when we sync. Nothing from an unfinished export may be used until a later sync, and it mustn't fail the sync.

If a row has the wrong number of fields, an amount that isn't a whole number of cents, or an ordered_at that isn't an ISO 8601 timestamp, the sync should exit non-zero before sending any record, with an error naming the file and the row's line number (the header is line 1).

Without `export_path` the tap must work as before, and the tests in /app/tests and the lint in /app/tox.ini (black, isort, flake8 and mypy) must keep passing. There's no network; everything the project needs is in /opt/venv.
